;; D19 demonstration, BEFORE: games/claude/pacman.txt's ghost encoding.
;; Each ghost is identity x floor: on-empty BPIK, on-dot DFJL, on-pellet
;; 0123 -- twelve characters for four ghosts in one mode, and every move
;; rule is a 3x3 floor product per ghost.  This slice is the straight-east
;; move for all four ghosts, gated by their heading registers.

GOAL
Z

D.-P.o2o-K---
%(e)e[e]e----

BIND g move_all "step all ghosts east"

CMD move_all
 TRY_ALL
  ZIP M ()[] G BPIK H DFJL O 0123
   ATOMIC
    Me

    MATCH1
     ZIP X GHO u -.o
      ZIP c -.o R GHO
       Xc uR
